headline: Taiwan's Foxconn tests electric vehicle platform for Poland's Izera brand
summary: Taiwanese electronics manufacturer Foxconn tested its proprietary EV platform in Taiwan as the structural foundation for Poland's proposed national electric car brand, Izera.
why: Foxconn is expanding beyond contract electronics manufacturing into contract EV design and assembly platform manufacturing.
